title: Confirm ViewPort lockup reduction holds under sustained load
description: Throttled rebuilds (2Hz), 4KB stream buffer, per-tick line cap (24) were added to stop GUI lockups in the live scan / beacon / probe monitors. Verify no lockups over a long scanall + beacon-mon session on hardware.

title: Verify multi-attack selection clearing on hardware
description: mm_select_target() deselects the previously-selected AP/station before selecting the new target, because Marauder 'select' toggles/accumulates. Confirm on hardware that firing deauth on AP B after AP A hits only B, not both.

title: Verify station Fox Hunt (foxhunt -s) on hardware
description: Confirm 'foxhunt -s <ap> <station>' from the station-detail scene produces a live RSSI meter that tracks the specific client. Only AP fox hunt (foxhunt -w) is hardware-confirmed so far.

title: Retry portscan integration (ESP32-C5 / reliable capture)
description: 'portscan -a -t <ip>' is a no-op on the S2; 'portscan -s <service>' needs a populated list -i and pingscan was flaky under rapid probing, so the found-format was never captured. Retry capture on the C5 (or a stable S2 session), then wire an L3 Port Scan action off the host list.

title: AirTag detection list (ESP32-C5)
description: Depends on BLE support landing (C5). Parse Marauder's AirTag/find-my scan output into a selectable list with per-device signal.

title: BLE device list (ESP32-C5)
description: S2 has no BT radio (sniffbt -> 'Bluetooth not supported'). C5 has BLE. Build a unified BLE device list mirroring the AP list UX (dedup, selectable, detail scene).

title: Add a deauth monitor (sniffdeauth)
description: Apply the same monitor pattern used for beacon/probe (dedup + count + noisiest-first, throttled rebuild) to 'sniffdeauth'. Blocked on capturing the real sniffdeauth serial line format over the UART bridge first (never guess formats).

title: 5 GHz scan + monitor support (ESP32-C5)
description: ESP32-S2 is 2.4GHz only. The incoming ESP32-C5 is dual-band. Surface 5GHz APs/channels in scanall, live scan, and the channel-hop monitors once the C5 is in hand.

title: Multi-SSID (multissid) monitor
description: Optional: surface multissid activity in a monitor view. Low priority; evaluate value first.

title: Pineapple / Karma monitor
description: Optional: apply the monitor pattern to Marauder's pineapple/karma detection if the serial output proves parseable and useful. Low priority.

title: BT-based sniff monitors (ESP32-C5)
description: Once BLE works on the C5, extend the monitor pattern to Bluetooth sniff modes (noisiest-first, counts).
